messages:
ellie (Sales): Heads up — Stratus Analytics started their POC this morning. They've been seeing slow TTFT on long prompts (~900 tokens). Reported median TTFT ~850ms, spike up to 1.6s. They're on hosted in eu-west-1, model redwood-7b-mono. Can we triage?
omar (SE): Got it. Do we have a request id / example? Are they using keepalive or single short-lived connections?
ellie (Sales): They gave req id `sreq_20260322_0915`. No keepalive, one request per doc. Also asked about interim pricing if we push them to Dedicated for headroom.
nora (Support): Pulled the trace for sreq_20260322_0915: ```INFO request=sreq_20260322_0915 route=/v1/generate model=redwood-7b-mono node=gw-eu-03 latency_first_token_ms=859 kv_cache_hit=false batch_id=0 rate_limit_status=ok``` Looks like kv cache miss and no batching.
diego (Eng Oncall): kv miss + batch 0 common for single-shot flows. For 900 token prompts, cold path can be high. What prefill settings are they on?
ellie (Sales): They said default prefill (off for them currently). Also they have a crawler that submits 30–70 tiny requests/sec alongside larger single-shot docs; they saw 429s during one spike.
kevin (Security): Stratus also flagged data residency; they want assurance that prefill/persistent sockets won't persist PII. We should confirm retention policy and mention option for Dedicated with customer KMS.
diego (Eng Oncall): Short term troubleshooting plan: 1) reproduce with staging using eu-west-1 and same seq len, prefill disabled; 2) try prefill_tokens=64 and connection keepalive; 3) test client-side batching for the crawler's small requests to reduce 429s.
omar (SE): Reproduced on staging: curl against staging endpoint with 900-token blob, no prefill -> first-token 0.84s, batch_id=0, kv_cache_hit=false. Enabling prefill_tokens=64 reduces first-token to ~260ms. Enabling keepalive + streaming reduces handshake overhead further.
nora (Support): Customer reported 429 bursts when crawler hit ~55 rps for ~20s. Their account has default soft limit 50 rps. We can do a temporary bump to 100 rps for 48h while they test batching.
diego (Eng Oncall): For the 429s we should also check queuing/backpressure on the edge gateway. If many single-shot requests saturate the per-worker input queue, the router starts rejecting. Short-term: grant temporary rate bump + recommend client batching/coalescing with a short batching window (20–50ms) for their crawler. Long-term: route them to a Dedicated pool with reserved concurrency and autoscale headroom.
ellie (Sales): Pricing ask: they want a quick estimate for a Dedicated trial to cover peak 80 rps and target p99 <500ms for these sequences. Can we ballpark?
omar (SE): Ballpark: Dedicated small (equiv 6xA100 fractional) with reserved concurrency should meet p99 <500ms for mixed 900-token workloads. I'll attach a formal quote separately. For immediate POC we can offer 48h rate bump + config suggestions.
kevin (Security): Confirmation for questionnaire: enabling prefill is transient; prompts pass through cache but we can set retention=0 and disable logs for their POC. For Dedicated we support customer-managed KMS and VPC-only egress. I'll draft an answer for their security PDF.
nora (Support): Suggested quick remediation steps for the customer: 1) enable prefill_tokens=64, 2) switch to HTTP keepalive + streaming, 3) implement client batching for crawler (20ms window), 4) accept 48h rate bump while testing. Minimal example config to share: ```{
  "prefill_policy": "prefix",
  "prefill_tokens": 64,
  "connection": {"keepalive": true, "streaming": true},
  "client_batching": {"enabled": true, "max_wait_ms": 25}
}```
omar (SE): I'll send a short repro guide showing staging numbers and the improvement with prefill. Diego — can you confirm KV encryption and whether prefill touches disk encryption?
diego (Eng Oncall): KV cache entries are encrypted at rest in hosted; prefill primes KV in memory and ephemeral storage. Hosted uses our managed keys; for Dedicated we can enable customer KMS/HSM. Prefill does not change retention defaults; we can suppress logs and set retention=0 for the POC.
ellie (Sales): I'll propose the short-term plan to Stratus: try the config above tonight, accept 48h rate bump, and we'll reconvene tomorrow. CC'ing Kevin and Nora for the questionnaire/ops notes.
deploy-bot: rollout prod/eu-west/redwood-7b-mono-2026-03-22 completed in 29s.
ellie (Sales): Thanks everyone — pinging the customer now. Will update thread with their overnight test results. :rocket:
